jobs.title: Data Analyst - Remote
jobs.description:
About the Company

About the Role

The Data Analyst supports client-facing and internal teams by analyzing financial, operational, market, and real estate data to deliver accurate and actionable business insights. This role focuses on financial modeling, data analysis, KPI development, reporting, dashboard development, and data quality. The analyst will work with large datasets and collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to translate complex data into clear reporting, analytical solutions, and executive-ready insights. The role supports real estate acquisitions, developments, portfolio analysis, and related financial decision-making.

Responsibilities

Build and maintain financial models, analytical tools, and reporting solutions for real estate acquisitions, developments, and portfolio analysis.
Analyze financial, operational, and market data to identify trends, variances, risks, and opportunities.
Perform cash flow analysis, lease analysis, valuation analysis, scenario modeling, sensitivity analysis, and stress testing.
Develop and maintain interactive dashboards and reporting solutions using Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms.
Perform end-to-end data analysis, including data extraction, cleansing, validation, transformation, KPI development, analysis, and visualization.
Write and maintain SQL queries to retrieve, manipulate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Design and document data models, metrics, calculations, and reporting logic to support consistent analytics.
Identify data quality issues and support processes for data integrity, governance, and validation.
Partner with business and technical teams to understand reporting requirements and translate them into technical analytics solutions.
Automate recurring reporting and analytical processes to improve efficiency, scalability, and accuracy.
Communicate analytical findings through clear visualizations, reports, and executive-ready presentations.

Qualifications

2–4+ years of experience in data analytics, financial analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role.

Required Skills

Experience with Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms.
Experience developing dashboards, KPIs, data models, and automated reporting.
Strong understanding of real estate financial metrics, including IRR, NOI, Cap Rate, DSCR, and cash flow analysis.
Advanced Excel skills with experience in financial modeling and working with large datasets.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail.
Strong communication skills with the ability to present complex analysis to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to translate business requirements into data, reporting, and technical solutions.

Preferred Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Economics, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
Experience working in a fast-paced, client-serving, or cross-functional environment.

Pay range and compensation package

Bonuses/Incentives: This position is not eligible for bonuses, incentives, or commissions.
Compensation may vary based on factors including education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, location, performance, applicable agreements, and business needs.

Responsibilities

Location: Saint Louis, MO, US
Work Arrangement: Remote
Experience: 2–4+ years
Focus Areas: Data Analytics, Financial Analysis, Business Intelligence, Real Estate Analytics, Financial Modeling, Reporting

Required Skills

Benefits: Eligible employees may receive medical, dental, and vision insurance; HSA; FSA; 401(k); life, disability, and AD&D insurance. Salaried personnel receive paid time off. Hourly employees may be eligible for paid sick leave as required by law or applicable Service Contract Act projects.

jobs.title: Environmental Field Technician - Emergency Response
jobs.description:
Hepaco, A Clean Harbors Company,
in Shelbyville, KY is seeking an Environmental Field Laborer to join our safety conscious team. This role will be active in the field responsible for the performance of tasks associated with hazardous waste clean-up, site-remediation, equipment decontamination and handling of hazardous materials.

Hepaco, A Clean Harbors Company,
is the leading provider of environmental, energy and industrial services throughout the United States, Canada, Mexico and Puerto Rico. Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. We are solving tough problems through innovation and proven methodology – come be part of the solution with us.

Why work for Hepaco, A Clean Harbors Company?

Health and Safety is our #1 priority and we live it 3-6-5!
Focus on maintaining sustainability and cleaning the Earth
Recruiting Pay range - $20-23+ hourly or more depending on experience
Comprehensive health benefits coverage after 30 days of full-time employment including 401K with Company match
Own part of the company with our Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Opportunities for growth and development for all the stages of your career
Company paid training and tuition reimbursement

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

Ensure Health and Safety is the number one goal by following policies, processes, and always acting in a safe manner
Engage in strenuous physical labor including lifting and pulling heavy objects
Operate light and heavy equipment, handles various hand tools and powered industrial tools, works with vibration-producing tools
Wear and properly use a variety of personal protective Equipment (PPE). Including respirators, skin, face, hand and foot protection in a multiple number of combinations
Work in various temperatures indoors and outdoors in all weather conditions
Work in atmospheres and locations with the potential for exposure to various chemical and physical agents, some of which may be hazardous, toxic, or corrosive
Work in potentially elevated noise levels, confined spaces, including lifting in areas of low clearance
Work at elevations including working from ladders and scaffolding
Assist in field sampling activities and calibration of meters
Climb ladders, scaffolding and into and out of trucks, tanks, and various other containers
Work extended (> 8 hrs.) time periods
Attend all compliance and safety update meetings
Inspect drums for container integrity and regulatory compliance
Safe loading and unloading of hazardous and non-hazardous waste
Conduct waste stream sampling and profiling as necessary
Follow all local, state (provincial) and federal compliance regulations and rules
Safely operate vehicles in accordance with U.S. DOT, local, state (provincial) and federal requirements
Safely observe all corporate operating guidelines and procedures
Observe all company environmental health and safety operating guidelines
Perform other duties as assigned
By position, ability to be on call for emergency response on rotating basis every other week
By position, site-remediation, equipment decontamination, and the handling of hazardous materials

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Reliable transportation
Ability to perform physical functions per Key Responsibilities
This position includes emergency response, a continuing condition of employment is agreeing to be on-call; on occasion working on weekends and holidays will be required; emergency response situations can extend beyond 8 hours, up to 12-24 hrs.
Perform physical functions per job requirements
Successfully complete a background check, drug test, and physical, by position
Per OSHA's Respiratory Protection standard, 29 CFR 1910.34, employees in positions requiring respirators are required to meet facial hair standards.

Preferred Qualifications

Valid Driver’s license
Previous relevant labor experience
